newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Orogen reports A$62.5 mln revenue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Orogen reports A$62.5 mln revenue.

text.p: Mining investor Orogen Minerals NL on Friday reported operating revenues for the December quarter of A$44.28 million from crude oil sales and A$18.22 million from gold.
Orogen, which was admitted to official quotation on November 1, said its mining and petroleum interests had been owned for the full December quarter.
The company reported production of 1.44 million barrels of oil and 37,576 ounces of gold.
Production costs totalled A$3.69 million for crude oil and A$9.34 million for gold.
Orogen, 51 percent owned by the Papua New Guinea government, has a stake in some of PNG's largest oil and gold projects, including the Kutubu oil field and the Porgera gold mine.
